n76bb1b914da.s:
Arrange the following in descending order of their share in India's installed power capacity:
A. Wind
B. Coal including lignite
C. Large hydro
D. Solar
n76bb1b914da.x: Coal including lignite (42.43%) leads, followed by solar (28.96%), wind (10.47%) and large hydro (9.58%).

n2d99e589160.s: How much solar capacity was added in India during 2025-26?
n2d99e589160.x: A record 44.6 GW of solar capacity was added during 2025-26.

ne1d7bb5ad61.s: NITI projects that coal's share in India's electricity generation may fall from about 74% to ____ by 2070.
ne1d7bb5ad61.x: NITI projects coal's share of generation could decline from about 74% to 6–10% by 2070.

n9a1d9eb0db6.s: India's installed capacity reached a 50 per cent non-fossil share approximately:
n9a1d9eb0db6.x: The 50 per cent non-fossil share in installed capacity was reached about five years before 2030.

n8ef0e95a3d9.s: On 6 August 2026, APERC approved in principle the purchase of 1,600 MW of coal power through tariff-based bidding under which Section of the Electricity Act, 2003?
n8ef0e95a3d9.x: APERC approved 1,600 MW of coal power through tariff-based bidding under Section 63 on the DBFOO model.

nc249188f3b2.s: Non-fossil sources make up over half of India's installed capacity, but roughly what share of actual electricity output?
nc249188f3b2.x: Non-fossil sources form more than half of installed capacity but only about 22% of output, showing the capacity-generation gap.

nbec75ef4e7e.s: India's 'One Nation-One Grid-One Frequency' power system is known as the:
o: World's largest set of isolated State grids
nbec75ef4e7e.x: India operates the world's largest synchronous grid under the One Nation-One Grid-One Frequency framework.

n56e30968c97.s: Which publication–publisher pair is correctly matched?
o: Statistical Review of World Energy – International Energy Agency
World Energy Outlook – Central Electricity Authority
World Energy Outlook – International Energy Agency
n56e30968c97.x: The World Energy Outlook is published by the IEA in Paris; the Statistical Review of World Energy is by the Energy Institute.

n3e9f6bf6b9a.s: The Electricity (Late Payment Surcharge and Related Matters) Rules, 2022 allow discoms to:
o: Fix tariffs without approval of the regulator
Obtain free power from renewable generators
Write off all dues owed to generators
n3e9f6bf6b9a.x: The 2022 Rules let discoms clear old dues in instalments and cut power-exchange access for defaulters.

nee1fe62d6fc.s: Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana (UDAY), launched in November 2015, mainly aimed at:
o: Financial turnaround and revival of DISCOMs
nee1fe62d6fc.x: UDAY was launched in November 2015 for the financial turnaround and revival of distribution companies.

nf9bcaede446.s: Agricultural feeders separated under RDSS are subsequently solarised under which scheme?
nf9bcaede446.x: Feeder separation continues under RDSS, and separated agricultural feeders are then solarised under PM-KUSUM.

n9da4b05740c.s: Which of the following pairs about India's village-electrification milestone is correctly matched?
o: State of the last village – Nagaland
n9da4b05740c.x: Leisang in Manipur was the last village electrified; the milestone came on 28 April 2018 with 18,374 villages electrified.

n8d813d55579.s: Which power plant–owner pair is NOT correctly matched?
n8d813d55579.x: Hinduja National Power in Visakhapatnam is owned by the Hinduja group, not APGENCO.

ne9195da0fb1.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched regarding Andhra Pradesh DISCOMs?
ne9195da0fb1.x: APSPDCL is headquartered at Tirupati, not Hyderabad; APCPDCL was re-formed in 2020 at Vijayawada.

n45515d3ec32.s: Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) are especially relevant to India's power system for:
o: Meeting the evening peak in demand
Reducing transmission losses on long lines
n45515d3ec32.x: BESS is highlighted for managing the evening demand peak, especially alongside variable renewable generation.

n47a9e5bf95d.s: Pumped-storage hydropower is especially useful for grid balancing because it is the:
o: Only storage that needs no reservoir
Only storage that works without transmission
n47a9e5bf95d.x: Pumped storage is the fastest-responding large-scale storage, useful for balancing renewables and peak demand.

n35b88e0333b.s: Which pumped-storage projects are exempted from concurrence of the Central Electricity Authority?
n35b88e0333b.x: Off-stream closed-loop pumped-storage projects are exempted from CEA concurrence.

nc3aa27ba664.s: Which UMPP–developer pair is correctly matched?
nc3aa27ba664.x: Krishnapatnam, Sasan and Tilaiya were associated with Reliance Power; Mundra was developed by Tata Power.

n3e514d2092f.s: Flue-gas desulphurisation (FGD) scrubbers in thermal power plants mainly trap:
n3e514d2092f.x: FGD scrubbers trap sulphur dioxide in the stacks of thermal power plants.

nd01afca95f3.s: Andhra Pradesh's hydro and reverse-pumped potential is about:
nd01afca95f3.x: Andhra Pradesh has about 4 GW of hydro and reverse-pumped potential.

ncd0476f8b43.s: Which project–river pair is correctly matched?
ncd0476f8b43.x: Subansiri Lower is on the Subansiri; Tehri is on the Bhagirathi and the Teesta projects are on the Teesta.

o: Displacement caused by the Tehri dam
Resettlement of people displaced by the Narmada project
Tree felling in the Garhwal Himalaya
nbf053892184.x: Rally for the Valley was an NBA campaign on the resettlement of people displaced by the Narmada project.

nbf3220bf187.s: The World Commission on Dams was set up in 1998 with the association of:
nbf3220bf187.x: The World Commission on Dams was associated with the World Bank and IUCN in 1998.

ndcbad781ee8.s: The Hydro Purchase Obligation requires discoms to buy a prescribed share of power from:
ndcbad781ee8.x: HPO is a separate obligation for discoms to buy large-hydro power, part of the March 2019 reforms.

n9ecdb108fd7.s: An Ultra Mega Power Project (UMPP) is a 4,000 MW ____ plant awarded through tariff-based bidding.
n9ecdb108fd7.x: A UMPP is a 4,000 MW supercritical coal plant awarded through tariff-based bidding.

n3d878da4b7a.s: Which State has the largest hydropower potential in India?
n3d878da4b7a.x: Arunachal Pradesh has the largest State-level hydropower potential.

n41e669f6db4.s: A major weakness of hydropower is its dependence on:
n41e669f6db4.x: Hydropower is renewable and flexible, but its output depends on drought and snowpack variability.

n7ab3d77bc24.s: Hydroelectricity is regarded as suitable for sustainable development mainly because it is:
n7ab3d77bc24.x: Hydroelectricity is cheap and clean once built, though large projects involve displacement and ecological trade-offs.

nd7948c356ed.s: Pumped-storage hydropower is classified as which type of energy storage?
nd7948c356ed.x: Pumped storage stores surplus power as water in an upper reservoir and releases it over peak hours: long-duration storage.

nc797a98ec5b.s: Light Water Reactors, which account for over 85% of world nuclear capacity, use light water as:
nc797a98ec5b.x: LWRs use light water for both moderation and cooling and make up more than 85% of global nuclear capacity.

n8af510eac71.s: NPCIL's proposed Bharat Small Reactors are based on the:
n8af510eac71.x: NPCIL sought proposals for 220 MW PHWR-based Bharat Small Reactors as captive plants for industry.

n5e3ff12621e.s: Which reactor component–function pair is correctly matched?
o: Moderator – carries heat from the core
n5e3ff12621e.x: The moderator slows neutrons; the coolant carries heat and control rods absorb neutrons.

n36c5805325a.s: The 300 MW Advanced Heavy Water Reactor (AHWR) designed by BARC uses which fuel combination?
n36c5805325a.x: The AHWR is a 300 MW thorium reactor with heavy-water moderator, boiling light-water coolant and Th-232 + U-233 fuel.

n24916d5d392.s: A Small Modular Reactor (SMR) has a capacity of up to ____ per unit.
n24916d5d392.x: An SMR has a capacity of up to 300 MWe per unit, about one-third the size of a conventional reactor.

ne48a856bcdf.s: Which nuclear power station has India's first fully indigenous PHWRs and is also associated with the PFBR?
ne48a856bcdf.x: Kalpakkam's MAPS units are the first fully indigenous PHWRs, and the site is associated with the PFBR.

nff58cffdce6.s: Which is India's second-largest operating nuclear power plant, at 1,840 MW?
nff58cffdce6.x: Kakrapar is the second-largest operating plant at 1,840 MW; Jaitapur (9,900 MW) is the largest planned plant.

n91b2d387a0d.s: Which nuclear project–State pair is correctly matched?
n91b2d387a0d.x: Kaiga is in Karnataka; Chutka is in Madhya Pradesh, Mahi Banswara in Rajasthan and Gorakhpur in Haryana.

nee13d9917c9.s: The proposed Kovvada nuclear power project is in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
nee13d9917c9.x: Kovvada is located in Srikakulam district of Andhra Pradesh.

n29e7e4b172f.s: The Kovvada nuclear project is proposed to use which reactors?
o: AP1000 reactors from the United States
n29e7e4b172f.x: Kovvada is proposed to use AP1000 reactors from the United States.

n4921bc9e8ae.s: The Mahi Banswara nuclear power project is being built by:
n4921bc9e8ae.x: Mahi Banswara is being developed by ASHVINI (Anushakti Vidhyut Nigam Limited), an NPCIL–NTPC joint venture.

n03c311af0cd.s: India's nuclear doctrine is based on a policy of:
o: First Use only against non-nuclear states
n03c311af0cd.x: India follows a No First Use policy; it is not a party to the TPNW.

na458b0b4744.s: The occupational dose limit for radiation workers, averaged over five years, is:
na458b0b4744.x: The limit is 20 mSv a year averaged over five years, with a maximum of 30 mSv in any one year and 100 mSv cumulative.

n28982399513.s: The Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT), which India has never signed, entered into force in:
n28982399513.x: The NPT dates from 1968 and entered into force in 1970; India has never signed it.

n5ec332a2799.s: Which radiation-protection principle requires exposure to be kept 'As Low As Reasonably Achievable'?
n5ec332a2799.x: ALARA is the principle requiring exposure to ionising radiation to be kept As Low As Reasonably Achievable.

ne610b1aee8a.s: Radioimmunoassay is used to measure minute quantities of ____ in blood.
ne610b1aee8a.x: Radioimmunoassay uses radioisotopes to measure minute quantities of hormones, enzymes and drugs in blood.

n940132d2c98.s: SPECT imaging generally uses which radioisotope?
n940132d2c98.x: SPECT uses single gamma emitters, chiefly Technetium-99m; PET uses positron emitters such as F-18 FDG.

n80fa6d4e340.s: Which radiation quantity–unit pair is correctly matched?
n80fa6d4e340.x: Absorbed dose is measured in Gray; activity is in Becquerel and biological effect in Sievert.

o: An external Co-60 beam from a distant unit
Injecting F-18 FDG to detect positrons
Placing a sealed radiation source inside or next to the tumour
nb15515a5837.x: Brachytherapy places a sealed source (e.g. Ir-192 or I-125 seeds) inside or next to the tumour; teletherapy is external-beam, commonly Co-60.

nc6a10f25409.s: The 30 MeV Medical Cyclotron at Kolkata commercially produces:
nc6a10f25409.x: The Kolkata Medical Cyclotron produces F-18 FDG commercially for PET imaging.

nfd758cc425e.s: TBM-9, a newer BARC Trombay variety developed with NRCB, Trichy, is a variety of:
nfd758cc425e.x: TBM-9 is the newer banana variety developed with NRCB, Trichy; RTS-43 is a sorghum variety.

n5dd3a5611d1.s: In the sterile insect technique, radiation-sterilised males are released so that:
o: Mating with wild females produces no viable offspring
n5dd3a5611d1.x: Gamma-sterilised males mate with wild females without producing viable offspring, so pest numbers decline.

n061418ff5dd.s: BRIT (Board of Radiation and Isotope Technology) is:
o: The regulator for radiation safety in India
An industrial unit of the Department of Atomic Energy for radioisotopes
A cancer hospital under the Ministry of Health
n061418ff5dd.x: BRIT is an industrial unit of the DAE dealing with radioisotopes, radiopharmaceuticals and isotope technology.

nb29725e065a.s: ISOMED 2.0, completed in May 2025, is a:
o: High-intensity gamma irradiator for sterilising healthcare products
nb29725e065a.x: ISOMED 2.0 is a high-intensity gamma irradiator for sterilising healthcare products, completed in May 2025.

naad629677d2.s: Of India's estimated solar potential of 748 GW, about what share had been utilised?
naad629677d2.x: India's solar potential is estimated at 748 GW, of which only about 4.5% had been utilised.

n19ac4a35f45.s: The Renewable Purchase Obligation (RPO) applies to:
o: DISCOMs and large or designated consumers
n19ac4a35f45.x: RPO requires DISCOMs and large or designated consumers to procure a prescribed share of power from renewables.

n6e4644d3b6a.s: Under the Energy Conservation (Amendment) Act, 2022, the Renewable Purchase Obligation has been recast as an obligation to:
n6e4644d3b6a.x: RPO concerns purchase of renewable power; the RCO recasts it as an obligation to consume renewable energy under the 2022 amendment.

ne2855806bdf.s: Inter-State Green Energy Corridor lines, which evacuate renewable power to load centres, are built by:
ne2855806bdf.x: Inter-State GEC lines are built by Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL).

n3c947cd196b.s: In a solar PV system, which device converts the DC produced by the cells into AC for the grid?
n3c947cd196b.x: PV cells produce direct current; an inverter converts it to alternating current. A transformer only changes voltage.

n154566367de.s: Which National Solar Mission phase–period pair is correctly matched?
n154566367de.x: Phase III covered 2017–2022; Phase I was 2010–2013 and Phase II 2014–2017.

n0d98ba086a0.s: Rooftop solar incentives, the ARUN app and Suryamitra skilling are associated with:
n0d98ba086a0.x: SRISTI is associated with rooftop incentives, the ARUN app and Suryamitra skill development.

nenvironment-1-1.s: India's first National Centre for Marine Biodiversity is at:
nenvironment-1-1.x: India's first National Centre for Marine Biodiversity is at Jamnagar, near the Gulf of Kachchh Marine National Park.

n19c894a7d57.s: Which scheme–purpose pair is correctly matched?
o: PM-KUSUM Component B – solarisation of grid-connected pumps
PM-KUSUM Component C – standalone solar pumps
VGF schemes – viability gap funding for grid-scale solar developers
Rooftop Solar Phase-II – floating solar generation
n19c894a7d57.x: VGF schemes, including JNNSM Phase-II through SECI, fund grid-scale solar developers; Component B is standalone pumps and Component C grid-connected pump solarisation.

n2e7db30dd20.s: The PM Surya Sarovar Yojana (₹5,070 crore) targets how much floating solar capacity by 2030–31?
n2e7db30dd20.x: The scheme involves ₹5,070 crore and targets 5,000 MW of floating solar by 2030–31.

n6ad54c39613.s: The Green Term Ahead Market (GTAM), launched in 2020 on the Indian Energy Exchange, is a trading segment for:
n6ad54c39613.x: GTAM is a renewable-energy-only trading segment on the IEX, launched in 2020.

n0c2bbb0d0d1.s: The Capacity Utilisation Factor (CUF) of a power plant is the ratio of:
o: Output at full rated power to actual output
Actual output to output at full rated power over the period
n0c2bbb0d0d1.x: CUF is actual output divided by the output possible at full rated power over the relevant period.

na3b75afc10d.s: The typical Capacity Utilisation Factor of wind power in India is about:
na3b75afc10d.x: Wind CUF is about 36–40%, above solar (~21%) but well below coal (~85%).

n0df40af9f29.s: The National Wind-Solar Hybrid Policy, 2018 promotes:
o: Separate wind and solar plants on different grids
Hybrid projects only for off-grid rural use
Replacing wind turbines with solar panels
Wind turbines and solar PV at the same grid connection point
n0df40af9f29.x: The policy promotes co-location of wind turbines and solar PV at the same point of grid connection.

n55411b4780a.s: The United States produces more ethanol than Brazil. Its principal feedstock is:
n55411b4780a.x: The US mainly uses maize or corn for ethanol, whereas Brazil mainly uses sugarcane.

n51810e51fd4.s: Unlike direct ethanol blending, Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uses:
n51810e51fd4.x: SAF uses drop-in synthesised hydrocarbons suited to aviation fuel systems, not simply direct ethanol.

nb1298f55eaf.s: Under the National Policy on Biofuels, which of the following is a 'basic' biofuel?
nb1298f55eaf.x: Basic biofuels are 1G bioethanol and biodiesel; 2G ethanol, drop-in fuels, 3G biofuels and bio-CNG are advanced biofuels.

ncfd3e5c9071.s: India's lead ocean-energy research body is:
ncfd3e5c9071.x: The National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT), Chennai, under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, is the lead ocean-energy research body.

n9128fe466cb.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n9128fe466cb.x: Panipat is the first commercial 2G plant; Larderello is the world geothermal first, Puga the Indian geothermal first and Numaligarh the first 2G bamboo plant.

nc8fc7eb59d0.s:
Assertion (A): Geothermal energy can provide 24×7 baseload power.
Reason (R): Geothermal energy comes from heat beneath the Earth's surface and does not depend on daily sunlight or wind.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nc8fc7eb59d0.x: Both are true, and the steady availability of underground heat explains why geothermal power can supply continuous baseload.

nc8c460d4f32.s: Since 2019, which source has been included in MNRE's renewable-energy classification?
nc8c460d4f32.x: Large hydro has been classified as renewable since 2019; nuclear is non-fossil but not renewable.

n7f8a00eff78.s: Which of the following is an example of biomass energy?
n7f8a00eff78.x: Gobar gas is biomass energy because it is produced from organic material, especially cattle dung.

nb5ebce93540.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nb5ebce93540.x: The Durgaduani Creek tidal pilot is in the Sundarbans; Vizhinjam is in Kerala.

nchemistry-10-19.s: Hydrogen is especially useful in sectors such as steel, shipping and fertilisers because in them:
nchemistry-10-19.x: Hydrogen suits hard-to-abate sectors like steel, shipping and fertilisers, where direct electrification is difficult.

nbcf9c26b62b.s: The National Green Hydrogen Mission targets green hydrogen production of ____ per year by 2030.
nbcf9c26b62b.x: The Mission targets 5 MMT a year by 2030, possibly reaching 10 MMT including exports.

n8acb2c5da23.s: Which port–State pair is correctly matched?
n8acb2c5da23.x: V.O. Chidambaranar (Tuticorin) is in Tamil Nadu; Deendayal (Kandla) is in Gujarat and Paradip in Odisha.

n5d719d394ae.s: India's first indigenous hydrogen fuel-cell bus (2022) was developed by:
n5d719d394ae.x: The first indigenous hydrogen fuel-cell bus was developed by KPIT with CSIR-NCL, Pune, in 2022.

n46a9e31c3ab.s: Liquid hydrogen is stored at a temperature of about:
n46a9e31c3ab.x: Liquid hydrogen is kept at about −253°C; its very low density (about 0.071 g/ml) needs large tanks.

n6ac2994c18b.s: Which group consists only of chemical carriers used to transport hydrogen for export?
n6ac2994c18b.x: Ammonia, methanol and liquid organic hydrogen carriers (LOHC) are chemical carriers for transporting hydrogen.

ne3feb8aba9f.s: Which non-rechargeable cell is commonly used in torches and clocks?
ne3feb8aba9f.x: The zinc-carbon dry cell is generally non-rechargeable and common in torches and clocks.

n3d46aaaed43.s: Which battery chemistry–application pair is correctly matched?
o: Lead-acid – grid-scale storage with separately scalable energy and power
Flow battery – automotive starting and UPS
n3d46aaaed43.x: Lead-acid serves automotive starting and UPS; flow batteries suit grid-scale storage and NMC (not LFP) has a nickel-manganese-cobalt cathode.
